thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 1978132460 - Canary rollout -> sticky fallback loop detected. Elevated 5xx rate for inference-api in eu-west-1 (customer-facing). Auto-alert: 6.8% errors, latency p95 1.2s. Link: https://incidents.internal/1978132460
sam_oncall: Paging oncall (sam). I'm on it, looking at dashboard now.
maria_cs: customer-reports: checkout failures for Acme Corp via EU region, they see "service unavailable" in prod. They're on slack.
ashley_sre: grabbing logs. early signs: canary variant (v2026.03.canary) returned an unexpected model binary -> mismatch causing tokenization errors -> requests failing and triggering fallback to sticky variant in same region which then trips capacity and loops.
ashley_sre: stack traces: `Error: incompatible-vocab: token id out of range` in runtime adapter
sam_oncall: can you confirm this is routing policy sticky fallback behavior? ash.
ashley_sre: yes. routing policy config has `sticky_fallback: true` and `ttl: 300s` but canary instances return error quickly causing fallback and sticky assignment to failing variant.
kartik_platform: recommend immediate mitigation: disable sticky fallback for canary route OR pause canary rollout. Which is faster?
lina_prod: pause rollout from console is quick. Doing now.
(1) console: paused canary rollout canary-2026-03-15 :white_check_mark:
maria_cs: pinging Acme to say we're investigating. keeping them updated.
ashley_sre: creating temporary route override to force stable variant for traffic from EU until root cause fixed.
ashley_sre: command:
```
# pin eu-west traffic to stable variant
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/v1/routing/overrides \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"scope":"eu-west-1","route":"inference-api","variant":"stable"}'
```
tom_support: applied override, confirmed 100% traffic to stable in eu-west. Monitoring.
sam_oncall: rolling back canary images from registry as a precaution: `rwctl deploy rollback --service inference-api --to v3.1.2` executed.
alex_research: note: failing canary was built with new tokenizer patch; mismatch between model artifacts produced by CI. Need to block that pipeline until we validate artifact compatibility.
ashley_sre: metrics: error rate dropped from 6.8% -> 0.9% over 3 mins after override. p95 latency normalized.
maria_cs: Acme acknowledges decreased errors. Thanks team.
lina_prod: handing off to kartik for follow-up and postmortem. I'm off in 20m. :wave:
sam_oncall: handoff to kartik_platform at 02:15 UTC. kartik, you're primary.
kartik_platform: taking over. Will coordinate root cause, rollback confirmation, and a mitigation runbook update. Next steps:
- remove canary images from registry tag `canary-2026.03.15`
- block CI pipeline for tokenizer change
- add integration check that validates vocab compatibility during build
- update routing policy defaults to require `fallback_approval` for canaries
ashley_sre: logging note: incidentbot created incident 1978132460 and set priority P1. Adding postmortem label.
sam_oncall: all customer-facing symptoms mitigated. Will keep monitoring for 1h.
maria_cs: Customer success will prepare communication for affected customers and offer support appts.
kartik_platform: starting postmortem draft now.
incident-bot: Incident 1978132460 status -> mitigated. Assigned to kartik_platform for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
